title: Editing: at least one permission must be turned on to save
custom_steps:
1. Untick every box in every card.
  2. Turn off every Page Access toggle, Settings sub-toggle, Parts Department card and Cross-Cutting Toggle.
  3. Click Save.
custom_expected: Save is blocked and a message tells you at least one permission must be turned on.
evidence: UI: editing a role down to zero permissions -> Save opens "Confirm Permission Updates" (Removed permissions listed) -> Confirm shows toast "At least one permission is required. Please try to resolve this." and the role is NOT saved (stays on edit). Submit-time validation enforces at least one permission. screenshot edit-zero-perm.
